follow-up time: During pregnancy, delivery, or within 42 days of termination of pregnancy
cohort: 1214 pregnant or postpartum women admitted to two major private hospitals in Harar and Dire Dawa, eastern Ethiopia
finding: The maternal near miss ratio was 92.1 per 1000 live births, with anemia, history of cesarean section, chronic hypertension, no antenatal care, and age > 35 being significantly associated with MNM.
mod_finding: Previous cesarean section was significantly associated with MNM.
